[SWS_ComM_01063]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09278
⌈If the API ComM_EcuM_WakeUpIndication() is called in PNC state COMM_PNC_NO_
COMMUNICATION, the configuration switch ComMSynchronousWakeUp is set to TRUE
(see [ECUC_ComM_00695]) and for all PNCs that reference at least one ComMChan-
nel via ComMChannelPerPnc (see [ECUC_ComM_00880]), the PNC main state
COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_-
PREPARE_SLEEP shall be entered.⌋
